spans.s:
हैम a. (मी f.) [हिम-हेमन्-अण्]
1
Cold, wintry, frigid.
--2 Caused
by frost; मृणालिनी हैममिवोपरागं

.
--4 Of a golden
yellow colour.
--मा --मी
Yellow jasmine.
--मं Hoar-frost,
dew.
--मः An epithet of Śiva.
--Comp.
--मुद्रा, --मुद्रिका a golden
coin.

हैमन a. (नी f.) [हेमंत एव हेमंते
भवो वा अण् तलोपः]
1 Wintry, cold;
Śi. 6. 55,

.
--2
Pertaining to winter, i. e. long (as nights);
Śi. 6. 77.
--3 Growing in or
suitable for winter; हैमनैर्निवसनैः
सुमध्यमाः

.
--4 Golden, made
of gold.
--नः
1 The month
Mārgaśīrsha.
--2 The winter season (= हेमंत
q. v.).

हैमंतिक a. [हेमंते काले भवः ठञ्]
1
Wintry, cold.
--2 Growing in
winter.
--कं A kind of rice.
हैमल See हेमतं.

हैमवत a. (ती f.) [हिमवतो
अदूरभवो देशः तस्येदं वा अण्]
1 Snowy.
--2
Flowing from the snowy, i. e.
Himālaya, mountain;

.
--3
Bred in, belonging to, or situated
on, the Himālaya mountain;

.
--तः A kind of
poison.
--तं Bhāratavarṣa or India.

1 N. of Pārvatī.
--2 Of
the river Ganges.
--3 A kind of
myrobalan.
--4 A kind of drug.
--5
Common flax.
--6 A tawny grape.
